blocks.text: Computer networks apne size aur phailao (coverage area) ke lihaz se taqseem kiye jate hain. Mukhtalif qismein mukhtalif maqasid ke liye use hoti hain, aur har qism devices ko apne tareeqe se jorti hai. Sab se aam qismein LAN, WAN aur Internet (aik public WAN) hain. Qismein samajhna sahi network chunne mein madad deta hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Computer networks faasle aur phailao ki bunyad par taqseem kiye jate hain.

blocks.caption: Computer network ki qismein
rows: Chhota ilaqa: ghar, school ya daftar
Data ki tez raftar; aam taur par aik idare ki milkiyat aur intizam; Ethernet aur Wi-Fi; sasta aur sambhalna asan
Bara jughrafiyai ilaqa: mukhtalif shehar ya mulk
Leased lines, satellites ya Internet; LAN se sust; lagana aur chalana mehnga
Sab se bara WAN, lakhon devices jorta; standard protocols; taleem, karobar aur tafreeh ke liye email, websites aur cloud storage

blocks.alt: LAN ke nishan wala khula ghar: deewar par teen antenna wala router cable se mez par rakhe desktop aur laptop, deewar par tablet aur farsh par doosre router se jura hai; farsh wala router printer se cable aur tablet se Wi-Fi se jura hai. Almari par TV rakha hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.3: Local Area Network (LAN) (kitab ki Figure 1.3 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: WAN ka nishan; Internet likhe teen badal tooti lakeeron se jure hain, aur har badal aik jagah ke Wi-Fi router se jura hai: computers aur phone wale do ghar, aur desktop computer wali daftar ki imarat.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.4: Wide Area Network (WAN) (kitab ki Figure 1.4 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Darmiyan mein globe (duniya ka gola), jo lakeeron se charon taraf ke devices se jura hai: do desktop computers, laptop, router, printer, server aur Wi-Fi ke nishan wale kai badal; kuch devices aapas mein bhi jure hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.5: Internet (kitab ki Figure 1.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Class activity
blocks.text: Internet use karne wali services ki fehrist banayein aur us ki ahmiyat par guftagu karein.

blocks.title: Dilchasp baat
blocks.text: DSL (Digital Subscriber Line) telephone lines ke zariye Internet deta hai aur aik hi waqt mein call aur browsing ki ijazat deta hai. ISP (Internet Service Provider) woh company hai jo users ko Internet faraham karti hai.

blocks.prompt: LAN kya hai? WAN se is ka aik farq batayein.
blocks.explanation: LAN chhote ilaqe, jaise ghar, school ya daftar, mein devices jorta hai. WAN ke baraks, jo shehar ya mulk dhanpta hai, yeh tez, sasta aur aam taur par aik idare ki milkiyat hota hai.

items: LAN: chhota ilaqa, tez, sasta, aik malik.
WAN: shehar ya mulk; leased lines ya satellites; sust aur mehnga.
Internet: sab se bara public WAN.
